6277-7084-8250.description:
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing another nonland creature you control.
When the creature dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, earthbending a land you control.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Activate Scarland Thrinax by sacrificing the earthbent land.
When the land dies, Beifong's Bounty Hunters triggers, returning the land from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped.
On Wings of Gold triggers, creating a creature token.
Resolve the Scarland Thrinax ability.
Repeat.

1274-3490-4050-8319.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1274-3490-4050-8319.description:
Gain life.
Heliod triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Greenhouse Propagator triggers, causing you to gain life.
Heliod triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding one mana of any color
Resolve the Heliod trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control that does not have summoning sickness

3259-7716.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-7716.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, Alien Invasion triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.

3240-3967-5631-6462.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Nether Traitor.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing another creature.
When the creature dies, Nether Traitor triggers, causing you to pay {B} to return Nether Traitor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Kheru Goldkeeper and Skeleton Crew triggers, creating a Treasure token and creature token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Repeat.

81-3099-3129-4762.description:
Activate Leyline of Abundance by paying {6}{G}{G}, putting four +1/+1 counters on each creature you control due to Primal Vigor and Kami of Whispered Hopes.
Activate Devoted Druid's first ability by tapping it, adding {G}.
Leyline of Abundance triggers, adding {G}.
Activate Devoted Druid's second ability by putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping Devoted Druid.
Repeat from step 2 three additional times.
Repeat from step 1.

1247-1528-2528.description:
Cast Channel the Suns by paying its mana cost.
Holding priority, activate Pili-Pala by paying {R} and tapping it, copying Channel the Suns.
Resolve the copy of Channel the Suns, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}
Activate Pili-Pala by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat from step 2.

140-1824-2530-5061.easyPrerequisites: You have not completed Tomb of Annihilation, nor are currently venturing in it.
140-1824-2530-5061.notablePrerequisites: You've lost 2 or more life this turn.
140-1824-2530-5061.description:
Activate Rowan by tapping it.
Cast Acererak by paying {B}.
Staff of the Death Magus triggers, causing you to gain life.
When Acererak enters, its first ability and Carnival of Souls trigger.
Resolve the Carnival of Souls trigger, causing you to add {B} and lose 1 life.
Resolve the Acererak trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand, and venturing into Lost Mine of Phandelver.
Repeat from step 2.

1395-3459-5078-6723.description:
Activate Battered Golem by tapping it, adding {1}.
Activate Sensei's Divining Top's second ability by tapping it, causing you to draw a card and put Sensei's Divining Top on top of your library.
Cast Sensei's Divining Top from the top of your library by paying {1}.
Elsha's prowess ability triggers, giving it +1/+1 until end of turn.
When Sensei's Divining Top enters, Battered Golem triggers, untapping Battered Golem.
Repeat.

1496-3490-5231-6824.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
1496-3490-5231-6824.description:
Gain life.
Spider-Man triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Verdant Sun's Avatar triggers, causing you to gain life.
Spider-Man triggers. Holding priority, activate Thermopod by sacrificing the Servo, adding {R}.
Resolve the Spider-Man trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Repeat from step 3.

3490-4017-4050-4476.description:
Gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on it.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Answered Prayers triggers, causing you to gain life.
The creature with Sunbond attached triggers. Holding priority, activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {1}.
Resolve the trigger from the creature with Sunbond attached, putting a +1/+1 counter on it 
Repeat from step 3.

862-3967-4053-6989.description:
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing Crimson Kobolds.
Cast Crimson Kobolds from your graveyard by paying {0}. It will not enter with a finality counter on it due to Solemnity.
Repeat.

141-1638-2060-6774.description:
Cast Quandrix Command by paying its mana cost, choosing its first and third modes.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, copying Quandrix Command, with the copy's first mode targeting Naru Meha and the copy's third mode targeting Crystalline Crawler.
Resolve the copy of Quandrix Command, returning Naru Meha from the battlefield to your hand and putting four +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler due to Loading Zone.
Holding priority, activate Crystalline Crawler three times by removing four +1/+1 counters from it, adding {2}{U}{U}.
Repeat from step 2.

141-313-2292.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
141-313-2292.description:
Cast Corpse Dance by paying its mana cost, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Naru Meha by paying its mana cost.
When Naru Meha enters, it triggers, targeting Corpse Dance.
Holding priority, activate Viscera Seer by sacrificing Naru Meha.
Resolve the Naru Meha trigger, copying Corpse Dance.
Resolve the Corpse Dance copy, returning Naru Meha from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.

147-2511-6928.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2511-6928.description:
Cast Prison Break either from your hand by paying {4}{B} or from your graveyard for its mayhem cost by paying {3}{B}, targeting any applicable target.
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Prison Break.
Holding priority, activate Bloodflow Connoisseur by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Prison Break, with the copy targeting Dualcaster Mage
Resolve the Prison Break copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2511-6928.notes: The cost can be reduced by {1} if Prison Break is in your graveyard.

339-677-1322-2034.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

2933-4013-5798-6791.description:
Activate Eldrazi Displacer by paying {2}{C}, blinking Drowner of Hope.
When Drowner of Hope enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two 1/1 Eldrazi Scion creature tokens.
Activate the Eldrazi Scions by tapping them, adding {2}.
Activate an Eldrazi Scion by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite tapped Eldrazi Scion tokens, you may sacrifice them for infinite {C}, and then forego tapping or sacrificing subsequent Eldrazi Scions.

1597-3464-3657.description:
Activate Gyre Sage by tapping it, adding at least {G}{G}{G}{G}{G}.
Cast Hyrax Tower Scout by paying {2}{G}.
When Hyrax Tower Scout enters the battlefield, it triggers, untapping Gyre Sage.
Activate Kogla by paying {1}{G}, returning Hyrax Tower Scout from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.
1597-3464-3657.notes: If you get infinite mana, you can repeat steps 2-5 infinitely to untap any other creature(s)

1323-1355-4687.notablePrerequisites: You control at least three enchantments.
1323-1355-4687.description:
Activate Experiment Kraj using Sanctum Weaver's ability by tapping it, adding at least {G/U}{G/U}{G/U}.
Activate Experiment Kraj using Gilder Bairn's ability by paying {2}{G/U} and untapping it, doubling each counter on target permanent.
Repeat.

997-1339-6625.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing another creature, causing you to scry 1.
Matoya triggers, causing you to draw a card.
The Locust God triggers, creating a 1/1 Insect creature token with flying and haste.
Repeat.

4083-6572.notablePrerequisites:
There are four card types among cards in your graveyard.
You have a way to deal noncombat damage to an opponent.
4083-6572.description:
Deal noncombat damage to an opponent.
Fear of Burning Alive triggers, dealing that much damage to a creature that opponent controls.
Repercussion triggers, dealing that much damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 2.
4083-6572.notes: You may begin the combo by dealing damage to an opponent's creature by swapping steps 2 and 3. You can also repeat this combo if you have multiple sources of dealing noncombat damage to an opponent, or if the source used deals damage to multiple opponents.

4484-4772-4871-6518.notablePrerequisites: A creature not named Ebondeath, Dracolich has died this turn.
4484-4772-4871-6518.description:
Cast Ebondeath from your graveyard by paying {B}{B}.
When Ebondeath enters, The Sibsig Ceremony triggers, destroying Ebondeath and creating two 2/2 Zombie Druid creature tokens.
When Ebondeath dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate two Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {B}{B}.
Repeat.

uses.n: Toralf, God of Fury // Toralf's Hammer

1605-1775-6488.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls two or more creatures that can be targeted by spells and abilities you control.
You have a way to deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures such that the excess damage doubled will deal excess damage to the second indestructible creature.
1605-1775-6488.description:
Activate Deathless Angel twice by paying {W}{W}{W}{W}, giving two creatures an opponent controls indestructible until end of turn.
Deal noncombat damage to one of the indestructible creatures, dealing an increased amount of damage instead due to Gratuitous Violence.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the second indestructible creature due to Gratuitous Violence.
Toralf triggers, dealing an amount of damage over the excess damage to the first indestructible creature due to Gratuitous Violence.
Repeat from step 3 an arbitrarily large number of times.
Resolve a Toralf trigger, dealing infinite damage to any target.
1605-1775-6488.notes: An example of the pre-requisite: If you give two creatures an opponent controls with toughness 2 and 3 indestructible, you would need to start the loop by dealing 4 noncombat damage to the creature with toughness equal to 2. This will deal 2 excess damage, which will be amplified to 4, thus dealing excess damage to the second creature and continuing the loop. It is recommended to start by giving the two smallest creatures possible indestructible and to target the smaller of the two creatures first.

uses.n: Valentin, Dean of the Vein // Lisette, Dean of the Root

567-3097-5641.description:
Cast Basking Broodscale by paying {1}{G}.
When Basking Broodscale enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers, causing you to gain 1 life.
Lisette triggers, causing you to pay {1} to put a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Basking Broodscale triggers, creating a 0/1 Eldrazi Spawn creature token.
When the Eldrazi Spawn enters the battlefield, Soul's Attendant triggers.
Holding priority, activate the Eldrazi Spawn by sacrificing it, adding {C}.
Resolve the Soul's Attendant trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Repeat from step 3.

1992-4802-5256.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one additional creature that has a +1/+1 counter on it.
1992-4802-5256.description:
Activate Altar of Dementia by sacrificing another creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
When the creature dies, Basri's Lieutenant's second ability triggers, creating a 2/2 Knight creature token that enters the battlefield with at least two +1/+1 counters due to Master Biomancer.
Resolve the Altar of Dementia ability, causing target player to mill cards equal to the sacrificed creature's power.
Repeat.

662-4365-4853-4917.notablePrerequisites: You control an additional artifact creature.
662-4365-4853-4917.description:
Activate Liquimental Coating by tapping it, causing Jan Jansen to become an artifact creature until end of turn.
Activate Jan Jansen's first ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact creature.
When the creature dies, Dross Scorpion triggers, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Jan Jansen ability, creating four Treasure tokens.
Activate Jan Jansen's second ability by tapping it and sacrificing a Treasure token, creating four 1/1 Construct artifact creature tokens.
Activate three Treasures by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {1}{W}{W}.
Activate Mondrak by paying {1}{W}{W} and sacrificing two Constructs.
When the Constructs die, Dross Scorpion triggers twice.
Resolve the first trigger, untapping Jan Jansen.
Repeat steps 2 through 5 one additional time.
Resolve the second Dross Scorpion trigger from step 8, untapping Jan Jansen.
Resolve the Mondrak ability from step 7, putting an indestructible counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.

292-1495-4772.description:
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to itself.
Rite of Passage triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on Triskelion.
Repeat an arbitrarily large number of times.
Move to the next turn, removing all damage marked on Triskelion.
Activate Triskelion by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, dealing 1 damage to any target.
Repeat step 5 as desired.
292-1495-4772.notes: You can remove counters to deal damage to creatures you control, putting infinite +1/+1 counters on them due to Rite of Passage.

3706-4289-4893-5153.notablePrerequisites: Sunstrike Legionnaire does not have summoning sickness.
3706-4289-4893-5153.description:
Tap Sunstrike Legionnaire to add {G}.
Pay {G} to create a 2/2 Wolf token.
Sunstrike Legionnaire triggers, untapping.
Repeat.
